etymology.historical_story: One documented origin of Unger is a German designation for a Hungarian, also used of someone with trading connections to Hungary. Such descriptions could become hereditary surnames and occur among German and Ashkenazic Jewish families. This history explains a naming pattern; it does not identify the nationality, religion, or ancestry of an unspecified modern bearer. [Dictionary of American Family Names, via FamilySearch](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=unger)
